company_name: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. Common Shares
title: Fenn Gibb South
summary: Fenn Gibb South is the southern claim block adjoining the Fenn-Gib gold deposit, twenty-one kilometres east of Matheson and eighty kilometres east of Timmins in the Abitibi.
body_markdown:
Nov 2, 2026 Q3 2026 MD&A


On November 2, 2026, Mayfair Gold Corp. (“Mayfair”) announced that the Fenn-Gib gold project has been selected as a designated project under the Government of Ontario’s new “One Project, One Process” (“1P1P”) framework. The designation is expected to streamline permitting and provide more predictable timelines. Mayfair expects the designation to accelerate progress toward a construction decision and, ultimately, production and free cash flow. Through the 1P1P framework, Mayfair expects to secure permits required to make a construction decision as early as 2028.
